name: Autograd Wrapper for Volume Rendering
aliases: Python autograd wrapper for volume rendering
definition: A Python `torch.autograd.Function` implementation that replaces the C++ autograd layer, routing between forward/backward C++ ops and handling gradient requirements.
summary: The Autograd Wrapper for Volume Rendering is a Python torch.autograd.Function that integrates differentiable volume rendering into PyTorch by routing execution to backward-aware or inference-optimized CUDA kernels.
